=== twaco mashup templates
Mashup templates
  blank           A single responsive center container
                  slots: center
  sidebar         Menu sidebar beside a center content area
                  slots: sidebar, center
  header-footer   Fixed header and footer around a center content area
                  slots: header, center, footer
  header-sidebar  Header above a menu sidebar and center content area
                  slots: header, body, sidebar, center
  sidebar-header  Menu sidebar the full height, a header and the page beside it (also app-shell)
                  slots: sidebar, main, header, center
  form-dialog     Title bar, fields, and a right-aligned action bar (also form, dialog)
                  slots: title, fields, actions
  form-2col       Title, full-width fields, and two equal form columns above actions
                  slots: title, fields, form-columns, left, right, actions
  confirm-dialog  Confirmation message with close and action areas (also confirm)
                  slots: close, message, actions
  list-page       Title and toolbar above a list body (also list)
                  slots: title, toolbar, body
  card            Card with a title, actions, and body
                  slots: header, title, actions, body
  master-detail   Side-by-side list and detail areas
                  slots: list, detail
  kpi-tile        Compact KPI title and centered value (also kpi)
                  slots: title, value
  filter-panel    Fixed filters beside flexible content (also filters)
                  slots: filter-column, filters, filter-footer, content
  tabs            A title above a tab set; --tab Label=Mashup shows a mashup in each tab (also tab-page)
                  slots: title, tabs
  tab-content     Toolbar and body for a tab; the host supplies the title and 24px gutter
                  slots: toolbar, body
  dashboard       A title, a row of four KPI tiles, and a side panel beside a main panel
                  slots: title, tiles, tile-1, tile-2, tile-3, tile-4, panels, side, main

=== twaco mashup templates blank
blank: A single responsive center container
  page       
with --master, the page mashup container goes in center
=== twaco mashup templates blank --json
{
  "name": "blank",
  "aliases": [],
  "summary": "A single responsive center container",
  "slots": [
    "center"
  ],
  "page": {},
  "master_slot": "center",
  "children": []
}
=== twaco mashup templates sidebar
sidebar: Menu sidebar beside a center content area
  page       row
    sidebar    row, holds ptcsmenubar
    center     column, fills
with --master, the page mashup container goes in center
=== twaco mashup templates sidebar --json
{
  "name": "sidebar",
  "aliases": [],
  "summary": "Menu sidebar beside a center content area",
  "slots": [
    "sidebar",
    "center"
  ],
  "page": {
    "flex-direction": "row",
    "align-items": "stretch"
  },
  "master_slot": "center",
  "children": [
    {
      "slot": "sidebar",
      "children": [],
      "widget": "ptcsmenubar",
      "fixed": null,
      "divider": false,
      "flex-direction": "row",
      "flex-grow": 0,
      "align-items": "stretch"
    },
    {
      "slot": "center",
      "children": [],
      "widget": null,
      "fixed": null,
      "divider": false,
      "flex-direction": "column",
      "flex-grow": 1,
      "align-items": "stretch"
    }
  ]
}
=== twaco mashup templates header-footer
header-footer: Fixed header and footer around a center content area
  page       column
    header     row, fixed 50px
    center     column, fills
    footer     row, fixed 40px
with --master, the page mashup container goes in center
=== twaco mashup templates header-footer --json
{
  "name": "header-footer",
  "aliases": [],
  "summary": "Fixed header and footer around a center content area",
  "slots": [
    "header",
    "center",
    "footer"
  ],
  "page": {
    "flex-direction": "column",
    "align-items": "stretch"
  },
  "master_slot": "center",
  "children": [
    {
      "slot": "header",
      "children": [],
      "widget": null,
      "fixed": "50px",
      "divider": false,
      "flex-direction": "row",
      "align-items": "center"
    },
    {
      "slot": "center",
      "children": [],
      "widget": null,
      "fixed": null,
      "divider": false,
      "flex-direction": "column",
      "flex-grow": 1,
      "align-items": "stretch"
    },
    {
      "slot": "footer",
      "children": [],
      "widget": null,
      "fixed": "40px",
      "divider": false,
      "flex-direction": "row",
      "align-items": "center"
    }
  ]
}
=== twaco mashup templates header-sidebar

  page       column
    header     row, space-between, fixed 50px
    body       row, fills
      sidebar    row, holds ptcsmenubar
      center     column, fills

{
  "name": "header-sidebar",
  "aliases": [],

  "slots": [
    "header",
    "body",
    "sidebar",
    "center"
  ],
  "page": {
    "flex-direction": "column",
    "align-items": "stretch"
  },
  "master_slot": "center",
  "children": [
    {
      "slot": "header",
      "children": [],
      "widget": null,
      "fixed": "50px",
      "divider": false,
      "flex-direction": "row",
      "align-items": "center",
      "justify-content": "space-between"
    },
    {
      "slot": "body",
      "children": [
        {
          "slot": "sidebar",
          "children": [],
          "widget": "ptcsmenubar",
          "fixed": null,
          "divider": false,
          "flex-direction": "row",
          "flex-grow": 0,
          "align-items": "stretch"
        },
        {
          "slot": "center",
          "children": [],
          "widget": null,
          "fixed": null,
          "divider": false,
          "flex-direction": "column",
          "flex-grow": 1,
          "align-items": "stretch"
        }
      ],
      "widget": null,
      "fixed": null,
      "divider": false,
      "flex-direction": "row",
      "flex-grow": 1,
      "align-items": "stretch"
    }
  ]
}
=== twaco mashup templates sidebar-header
sidebar-header: Menu sidebar the full height, a header and the page beside it
aliases: app-shell
  page       row
    sidebar    row, holds ptcsmenubar
    main       column, fills
      header     row, space-between, fixed 50px
      divider    fixed 1px
      center     column, fills
with --master, the page mashup container goes in center
=== twaco mashup templates sidebar-header --json
{
  "name": "sidebar-header",
  "aliases": [
    "app-shell"
  ],
  "summary": "Menu sidebar the full height, a header and the page beside it",
  "slots": [
    "sidebar",
    "main",
    "header",
    "center"
  ],
  "page": {
    "flex-direction": "row",
    "align-items": "stretch"
  },
  "master_slot": "center",
  "children": [
    {
      "slot": "sidebar",
      "children": [],
      "widget": "ptcsmenubar",
      "fixed": null,
      "divider": false,
      "flex-direction": "row",
      "flex-grow": 0,
      "align-items": "stretch"
    },
    {
      "slot": "main",
      "children": [
        {
          "slot": "header",
          "children": [],
          "widget": null,
          "fixed": "50px",
          "divider": false,
          "flex-direction": "row",
          "align-items": "center",
          "justify-content": "space-between"
        },
        {
          "slot": null,
          "children": [],
          "widget": null,
          "fixed": null,
          "divider": true
        },
        {
          "slot": "center",
          "children": [],
          "widget": null,
          "fixed": null,
          "divider": false,
          "flex-direction": "column",
          "flex-grow": 1,
          "align-items": "stretch"
        }
      ],
      "widget": null,
      "fixed": null,
      "divider": false,
      "flex-direction": "column",
      "flex-grow": 1,
      "align-items": "stretch"
    }
  ]
}
=== twaco mashup templates form-dialog
form-dialog: Title bar, fields, and a right-aligned action bar
aliases: form, dialog
  page       column
    title      row, fixed 50px
    fields     column, fills
    actions    row, flex-end, fixed 50px
with --master, the page mashup container goes in fields
=== twaco mashup templates form-dialog --json
{
  "name": "form-dialog",
  "aliases": [
    "form",
    "dialog"
  ],
  "summary": "Title bar, fields, and a right-aligned action bar",
  "slots": [
    "title",
    "fields",
    "actions"
  ],
  "page": {
    "flex-direction": "column",
    "align-items": "stretch"
  },
  "master_slot": "fields",
  "children": [
    {
      "slot": "title",
      "children": [],
      "widget": null,
      "fixed": "50px",
      "divider": false,
      "flex-direction": "row",
      "align-items": "center"
    },
    {
      "slot": "fields",
      "children": [],
      "widget": null,
      "fixed": null,
      "divider": false,
      "flex-direction": "column",
      "flex-grow": 1,
      "align-items": "stretch"
    },
    {
      "slot": "actions",
      "children": [],
      "widget": null,
      "fixed": "50px",
      "divider": false,
      "flex-direction": "row",
      "justify-content": "flex-end",
      "align-items": "center"
    }
  ]
}
=== twaco mashup templates form-2col
form-2col: Title, full-width fields, and two equal form columns above actions
  page       column
    title      row, fixed 50px
    fields     column
    form-columns row, fills
      left       column, fills
      right      column, fills
    actions    row, flex-end, fixed 50px
with --master, the page mashup container goes in fields
=== twaco mashup templates form-2col --json
{
  "name": "form-2col",
  "aliases": [],
  "summary": "Title, full-width fields, and two equal form columns above actions",
  "slots": [
    "title",
    "fields",
    "form-columns",
    "left",
    "right",
    "actions"
  ],
  "page": {
    "flex-direction": "column",
    "align-items": "stretch"
  },
  "master_slot": "fields",
  "children": [
    {
      "slot": "title",
      "children": [],
      "widget": null,
      "fixed": "50px",
      "divider": false,
      "flex-direction": "row",
      "align-items": "center"
    },
    {
      "slot": "fields",
      "children": [],
      "widget": null,
      "fixed": null,
      "divider": false,
      "flex-direction": "column",
      "flex-grow": 0,
      "align-items": "stretch"
    },
    {
      "slot": "form-columns",
      "children": [
        {
          "slot": "left",
          "children": [],
          "widget": null,
          "fixed": null,
          "divider": false,
          "flex-direction": "column",
          "flex-grow": 1,
          "flex-basis": "0px",
          "align-items": "stretch"
        },
        {
          "slot": "right",
          "children": [],
          "widget": null,
          "fixed": null,
          "divider": false,
          "flex-direction": "column",
          "flex-grow": 1,
          "flex-basis": "0px",
          "align-items": "stretch"
        }
      ],
      "widget": null,
      "fixed": null,
      "divider": false,
      "flex-direction": "row",
      "align-items": "flex-start",
      "flex-grow": 1
    },
    {
      "slot": "actions",
      "children": [],
      "widget": null,
      "fixed": "50px",
      "divider": false,
      "flex-direction": "row",
      "justify-content": "flex-end",
      "align-items": "center"
    }
  ]
}
=== twaco mashup templates confirm-dialog
confirm-dialog: Confirmation message with close and action areas
aliases: confirm
  page       column
    close      row, flex-end, fixed 42px
    message    column, fills, center
    actions    row, flex-end, fixed 50px
with --master, the page mashup container goes in message
=== twaco mashup templates confirm-dialog --json
{
  "name": "confirm-dialog",
  "aliases": [
    "confirm"
  ],
  "summary": "Confirmation message with close and action areas",
  "slots": [
    "close",
    "message",
    "actions"
  ],
  "page": {
    "flex-direction": "column",
    "align-items": "stretch"
  },
  "master_slot": "message",
  "children": [
    {
      "slot": "close",
      "children": [],
      "widget": null,
      "fixed": "42px",
      "divider": false,
      "flex-direction": "row",
      "justify-content": "flex-end",
      "align-items": "center"
    },
    {
      "slot": "message",
      "children": [],
      "widget": null,
      "fixed": null,
      "divider": false,
      "flex-direction": "column",
      "flex-grow": 1,
      "justify-content": "center",
      "align-items": "stretch"
    },
    {
      "slot": "actions",
      "children": [],
      "widget": null,
      "fixed": "50px",
      "divider": false,
      "flex-direction": "row",
      "justify-content": "flex-end",
      "align-items": "center"
    }
  ]
}
=== twaco mashup templates list-page
list-page: Title and toolbar above a list body

=== twaco mashup templates list-page --json
{
  "name": "list-page",
  "aliases": [
    "list"
  ],
  "summary": "Title and toolbar above a list body",
  "slots": [
    "title",
    "toolbar",
    "body"
  ],
  "page": {
    "flex-direction": "column",
    "align-items": "stretch",
    "Margin": "24"
  },
  "master_slot": "body",
  "children": [
    {
      "slot": "title",
      "children": [],
      "widget": null,
      "fixed": "70px",
      "divider": false,
      "flex-direction": "row",
      "align-items": "center"
    },
    {
      "slot": "toolbar",
      "children": [],
      "widget": null,
      "fixed": "50px",
      "divider": false,
      "style": {
        "background": "#F7F7F7"
      },
      "flex-direction": "row",
      "align-items": "center"
    },
    {
      "slot": "body",
      "children": [],
      "widget": null,
      "fixed": null,
      "divider": false,
      "flex-direction": "column",
      "flex-grow": 1,
      "align-items": "stretch"
    }
  ]
}

=== twaco mashup templates filter-panel
filter-panel: Fixed filters beside flexible content
aliases: filters
  page       row
    filter-column column, fixed 276px
      filters    column, fills
      divider    fixed 1px
      filter-footer row, space-between
    divider    fixed 1px
    content    column, fills
with --master, the page mashup container goes in content
=== twaco mashup templates filter-panel --json
{
  "name": "filter-panel",
  "aliases": [
    "filters"
  ],
  "summary": "Fixed filters beside flexible content",
  "slots": [
    "filter-column",
    "filters",
    "filter-footer",
    "content"
  ],
  "page": {
    "flex-direction": "row",
    "align-items": "stretch"
  },
  "master_slot": "content",
  "children": [
    {
      "slot": "filter-column",
      "children": [
        {
          "slot": "filters",
          "children": [],
          "widget": null,
          "fixed": null,
          "divider": false,
          "style": {
            "background": "inherit"
          },
          "flex-direction": "column",
          "align-items": "flex-start",
          "flex-size": "range",
          "flex-min-width": "240px",
          "flex-max-width": "240px",
          "flex-shrink": 0,
          "Margin": "",
          "flex-grow": 1
        },

=== twaco mashup templates tabs
tabs: A title above a tab set; --tab Label=Mashup shows a mashup in each tab
aliases: tab-page
  page       column
    title      row, fixed 70px
    tabs       row, fills, holds ptcstabset
=== twaco mashup templates tabs --json
{
  "name": "tabs",
  "aliases": [
    "tab-page"
  ],
  "summary": "A title above a tab set; --tab Label=Mashup shows a mashup in each tab",
  "slots": [
    "title",
    "tabs"
  ],
  "page": {
    "flex-direction": "column",
    "align-items": "stretch",
    "Margin": "24"
  },
  "master_slot": null,
  "children": [
    {
      "slot": "title",
      "children": [],
      "widget": null,
      "fixed": "70px",
      "divider": false,
      "flex-direction": "row",
      "align-items": "center"
    },
    {
      "slot": "tabs",
      "children": [],
      "widget": "ptcstabset",
      "fixed": null,
      "divider": false,
      "flex-direction": "row",
      "Scrolling": "auto-scroll",
      "flex-grow": 1,
      "align-items": "stretch"
    }
  ]
}

=== twaco mashup templates dashboard
dashboard: A title, a row of four KPI tiles, and a side panel beside a main panel
  page       column
    title      row, fixed 40px
    tiles      row, fixed 240px
      tile-1     column, fills
      tile-2     column, fills
      tile-3     column, fills
      tile-4     column, fills
    panels     row, fills
      side       column, fills
      main       column
with --master, the page mashup container goes in main
